source.quote_free_summary: Competitors must be in attendance at least one-half hour before the advertised time of their events, and organizers need not delay the program for latecomers.

requirement: A future NDCA profile may derive the commit window from the thirty-minute attendance expectation; DanceFlow never delays or penalizes on the competitor's behalf.
